You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage):
Forest Gnome. You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.
Rock Gnome. You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from Prestidigitation; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it.
For example, if you choose the spell's ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn't do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

entries.source_excerpt:
# Alert

## Feats

*Origin Feat*

You gain the following benefits.

***Initiative Proficiency.*** When you roll [Initiative](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Combat?expansion=32231#Initiative), you can add your [Proficiency Bonus](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Proficiency?expansion=32231) to the roll.

***Initiative Swap.*** Immediately after you roll [Initiative](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Combat?expansion=32231#Initiative), you can swap your [Initiative](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Combat?expansion=32231#Initiative) with the [Initiative](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Combat?expansion=32231#Initiative) of one willing ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the [Incapacitated](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Incapacitated%20%5BCondition%5D) condition.

# Crossbow Expert

## Feats

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity 13+)*

You gain the following benefits.

# Mounted Combatant

## Feats

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)*

You gain the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Strength](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), [Dexterity](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), or [Wisdom score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Mounted Strike.*** While mounted, you have [Advantage](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Advantage) on [attack rolls](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Attack%20Roll) against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is at least one size smaller than the mount.

***Leap Aside.*** If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a [Dexterity saving throw](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Saving%20Throw) to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the [saving throw](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Saving%20Throw) and only half damage if it fails. For your mount to gain this benefit, you must be riding it, and neither of you can have the [Incapacitated](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Incapacitated%20%5BCondition%5D) condition.

***Veer.*** While mounted, you can force an attack that hits your mount to hit you instead if you don’t have the [Incapacitated](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Incapacitated%20%5BCondition%5D) condition.
findings: Description restricts advantage to melee attacks; source applies attack rolls versus unmounted creatures within 5 ft of mount and smaller than mount. Omits incapacitation constraints.

# Ritual Caster

## Feats

![](https://files.d20.io/images/406408921/yDSQBvfMutyMiH9ZoYlUAg/original.png?1724434052)

*General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+; Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma 13+)*

You gain the following benefits.

***Ability Score Increase.*** Increase your [Intelligence](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), [Wisdom](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231), or [Charisma score](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:The%20Six%20Abilities?expansion=32231) by 1, to a maximum of 20.

***Ritual Spells.*** Choose a number of level 1 [spells](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Spell) equal to your [Proficiency Bonus](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Proficiency?expansion=32231#Proficiency%20Bonus) that have the [Ritual](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Ritual) tag. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. # Healer

## Feats

*Origin Feat*

You gain the following benefits.

***Battle Medic.*** If you have a [Healer’s Kit](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Items:Healer's%20Kit?expansion=32231), you can expend one use of it and tend to a creature within 5 feet of yourself as a [Utilize](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Utilize%20%5BAction%5D) action. That creature can expend one of its [Hit Point Dice](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Step%205%20-%20Fill%20In%20Details?expansion=32231), and you then roll that die. The creature regains a number of [Hit Points](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Damage%20and%20Healing?expansion=32231#Hit%20Points) equal to the roll plus your [Proficiency Bonus](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Proficiency?expansion=32231).

***Healing Rerolls.*** Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of [Hit Points](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Damage%20and%20Healing?expansion=32231#Hit%20Points) you restore with a [spell](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Spell) or with this feat’s Battle Medic benefit, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

***Luck Points.*** You have a number of Luck Points equal to your [Proficiency Bonus](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Proficiency?expansion=32231) and can spend the points on the benefits below. You regain your expended Luck Points when you finish a [Long Rest](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Long%20Rest).

***Advantage.*** When you roll a d20 for a [D20 Test](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:D20%20Tests?expansion=32231), you can spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself [Advantage](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Advantage) on the roll.

***Disadvantage.*** When a creature rolls a d20 for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose [Disadvantage](https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Rules:Rules%20Definitions?expansion=32231#Disadvantage) on that roll.
